description: Proposed single storey ground floor rear extension with garage conversion into a  habitable room including front dormer window and a rooflight to the front and rear
decision_conditions: The proposed hip to gable over the existing characteristic two storey front projection would by reason its combined scale, bulk, mass and unbalancing effect be unduly prominent and detract from the character and appearance of the street scene and rear garden environment contrary to Policy 26 of the Local Plan 2021, the Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2011), Policy D4 of the London Plan and also the guidance within the NPPF.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy, notification of intended refusal and the reason(s) for it was given to Civil Consulting Limited, by email on 08/09/26.
